title: Saudi Legal Corpus for AI
description: A machine-readable dataset of Saudi legislation: 291 legislative tracks and 15,689 article-level records with official-source provenance, derived analytical layers, and a 519-query retrieval benchmark. This release is not an official government publication, does not provide legal advice, and is not a substitute for the official Arabic texts published by the competent authorities in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The official Arabic text governs in all cases.
